description: Two invented, non-person claims used only to verify timestamped HumanState snapshot contracts and replay.

model_estimated_frustration.note: Observable repeated failure supports a frustration hypothesis; it is not private-emotion ground truth.

model_estimated_focus.note: Pause-and-diagnose observations support a model-estimated task-focus variable.

reliability_over_persistence.note: Repeated observable reassessment is treated as a bounded preference hypothesis.

diagnose_repeated_failure.note: The estimated active goal is grounded in current technical failure and similar observations.

pause_after_repeated_failure.note: Two prior observable examples support a limited habit estimate.

adaptive_reassessment_tendency.note: This slow-state tendency remains low-confidence because the fixture has only two examples.

activity.note: Current activity is directly supplied by the observable event.

repeated_failure.note: Repeated failure is explicitly present in the observable event.

private_fatigue.note: No observable evidence establishes private fatigue.

role.note: The current event explicitly identifies the team role.

familiarity.note: Recurring team interaction supports only a bounded familiarity estimate.

trust.note: The fixture does not establish interpersonal trust.

affinity.note: The fixture does not establish private affinity.

conflict.note: No overt conflict is observed, but absence is weak evidence.

interaction_frequency.note: Repeated team observations support a limited interaction-frequency estimate.

model_estimated_irritation.note: Boundary violations support an irritation hypothesis but do not reveal actual private emotion.

model_estimated_caution.note: Observed privacy protection supports a model-estimated caution variable.

privacy_boundary_priority.note: Repeated observable refusals support a high boundary-priority estimate.

protect_private_information.note: The active-goal estimate is grounded in the current request and two prior boundary observations.

direct_boundary_enforcement.note: Two direct observable refusals support a bounded habit estimate.

boundary_directness_tendency.note: This is a model tendency derived from public behavior, not a private-person fact.

request_type.note: The observable event explicitly asks for private information.

boundary_already_relevant.note: Current and prior evidence makes the boundary context highly supported.

private_offline_consequence.note: No observable evidence establishes offline consequences.

role.note: The current event explicitly identifies the audience role.

familiarity.note: A recurring public-audience context supports only a low-confidence familiarity estimate.

trust.note: No public evidence establishes trust toward this audience request.

affinity.note: No public evidence establishes private affinity.

conflict.note: Repeated boundary pressure supports a bounded interaction-conflict estimate.

interaction_frequency.note: One recurring public context supports a weak frequency estimate.
